# Webry Nuxt SaaS

_A modern SaaS template using Nuxt, Shadcn, Postgres, OAuth, Resend, ... 🚀_

</div>

&nbsp;

## Why does this exist?
Every SaaS idea needs the same auth/db/email plumbing; this is that plumbing done once.

## Where to find it

Live at [saas.webry.com](https://saas.webry.com/).
